lena: quick brainstorm — lightweight 'cohort token-bucket' safety for runtime flags. goal: stop rapid wide flips that spike quotas/routing.

josh: is this per-activation or per-token?
lena: per-activation (tokens represent activations). small burst then exponential backoff. enforced in-runtime via local token-bucket to avoid extra RPCs.
ravi: caller behavior when exhausted? queue or fail?
lena: fail-fast with Retry-After. Console will mark flag as 'throttled by safety' and allow owner override with justification + TTL.
maya: UX: surface current tokens, recent backoff windows, last blocked trace id, and afford a "start dry-run" button. require 2FA + owner role to escalate. Keep copy plain for PMs.
devon: metrics: config.activation_rate, config.blocked_activations, config.override_attempts, config.override_approvals. propose alert: blocked_activations > 20 in 5m for prod cohorts.
cara: SRE: default fail-mode by risk: infra flags fail-closed, non-critical fail-open. Add an oncall-only safemode bypass with audit log + TTL. suggested backoff schedule: 10s,30s,120s,600s.
josh: implement token-bucket in runtime cache; on stale cache do a tiny circuit RPC to config service. perf estimate: ~1% p95 overhead at 10k rps if optimized. Need bench.
lena: sample dry-run JSON kept in RFC doc (linked after preflight).
configbot: preflight: schema OK. WARNING: telemetry hooks missing (config.blocked_activations). Auto-insert telemetry scaffolding recommended.
ravi: auto-insert telemetry during preflight is a strong +1. fail preflight if missing.
maya: Console copy when throttled: short reason, "why this happened", recommended next steps, and "open dry-run" button. timeline view: activations vs blocks.
devon: I'll draft SLI thresholds and alert windows. starting point: alert when blocked_activations > 20 in 5m AND activation_rate drops > 20% vs baseline.
cara: I'll draft safemode runbook: RBAC, audit, revoke, TTL, postmortem checklist.
josh: I'll build perf harness and bench token-bucket.
lena: Action items: lena -> RFC + PoC; josh -> perf; devon -> SLIs/alerts; cara -> runbook; maya -> console mocks. reconvene after PoC.
configbot: reminder: create RFC under /eng/flags/rfcs and attach preflight id 4419998888.
lena: thanks :rocket:
